title: verdunski
description: I’m a big fan of Mac Dre and his and those hyphy sounds of the Bay Area that I grew up with. Dancing at the Burn this year I felt very much connected with my hyphy ancestors as I danced to various EDM DJs and when I came home came up with this lil jig and started writing to it about my Burn experience. And while we are here…Rest in peace young Jigga. Talked to your mom and she misses you. Enjoy doggy paradise 🙂❤️

title: pursuitofme x ricky
description:
I wrote a story about prehistoric peeps finding mushies and how it affected the way they thought and interacted. This is that arranged into song. 

Prod flavorful croissants
Vocals 720M

Lyrics

We move. We kill. We eat what’s left.
The bones crack — marrow heat in the chest.
I don’t think. I follow. I hunt.
Matriarch north — I do what she wants.

Sky too wide, wolves too near,
Hard world hum, I swallow my fear.
Snowline track, spear dull but clear,
Lost that rabbit but the gods drew near.

Red
